text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting North York Community Council to authorize the installation of all-way stop control at the intersection of Dudley Avenue and Alfred Avenue. The installation of an all-way stop control at the intersection of Dudley Avenue and Alfred Avenue will enhance traffic safety while also stopping the traffic on the approach with the minor volume (Alfred Avenue).
North York Community Council: 1. Authorized all-way stop control at the intersection of Dudley Avenue and Alfred Avenue.
